text: The jacket fabric is soft, warm, and true to size. But the delivery arrived 6 days late in a damaged box, and the courier was completely unhelpful.
Super fast shipping! Ordered on Tuesday and package arrived on Wednesday morning. The material feels durable and the price was a huge bargain.
Extremely flimsy material, seams unravelled on the first wash. I requested a return and refund over a week ago, yet nobody responded to my ticket. Unacceptable service!
The shoes look stylish and genuine craftsmanship is noticeable. However, the sizing is tight around the toes and hurts to walk in. Will exchange for a larger size.
Customer service agent Michael was super polite and processed my exchange in 5 minutes! The replacement arrived spotless. Will definitely shop here again.
Overpriced for what you get. Cheap plastic feel, and shipping cost nearly half the product price. Not worth it.
